name: Korean Mewtwo Sealed Battle participation prize
short: Korean Mewtwo Sealed Battle participation prize

description.text: The participation prize of the Mewtwo sealed battles played with the enhanced expansion pack Remix Bout, in which each player opened ten packs on site and built a 40-card deck: the promo card Erika 171/SM-P. The SR battles ran from 10 September 2019 at authorized card shops and on 28 September at Pokémon Korea's headquarters, and the HR battles from 19 October 2019.
